Centrus ships first centrifuge for Piketon plant expansion
articles.원문 요약: Centrus Energy's manufacturing plant in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, has despatched the first new centrifuge as part of the company's multibillion-dollar expansion of its uranium enrichment capacity in Piketon, Ohio.

Framatome has inaugurated a chromium-coating industrial pilot facility dedicated to the industrialisation of its PROtect Enhanced Accident Tolerant Fuel technology at its manufacturing plant in Paimboeuf in western France.

articles.제목: Floating nuclear power plant 'has boosted air quality'
articles.원문 요약: An environmental monitoring report for Russia's floating nuclear power plant suggests that emissions have fallen almost 80% since it started supplying heating in the area in 2022.

articles.제목: Cernavoda units remain shut down due to Danube water levels
articles.원문 요약: Romania's Nuclearelectrica says that although there has been a recent rise in the local water level in the River Danube, current forecasts do not yet support a decision to restart the units.

articles.제목: Doosan to manufacture upper reactor vessel for NuScale SMR
articles.원문 요약: US small modular reactor developer NuScale Power has signed a contract with South Korea's Doosan Enerbility to manufacture an upper reactor coolant system for the NuScale Power Module.

articles.제목: Game of Thrones actor aims to highlight Chernobyl's need for international support
articles.원문 요약: Danish actor and United Nations Goodwill Ambassador Nikolaj Coster-Waldau has visited the Chernobyl nuclear power plant site, for a project which "aims to draw international attention to the need for support in restoring the New Safe Confinement, protecting the environment and ensuring radiation safety".
